## Checks

- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] `node tools/sim.mjs` rerun after rule or balance changes
- [ ] New site files added to the workflow's copy step and, if needed offline, to `SHELL` in `sw.js` (rename `CACHE` when caching changes)
- [ ] Visible text only in `lang/`; no em-dashes; typographic apostrophes
- [ ] No attribution lines (no `Co-Authored-By`, no "Generated with")

## Translations

- [ ] New keys added to every `lang/*.json`
